title: Kino Launches End to End AI Video Platform Integrated With Claude Code and Codex
summary:
Luke Igel introduced Kino, a new software platform that uses Claude Code and Codex to automate the end to end process of video production. The tool allows creators to upload raw footage to generate highlights and edit clips, while providing a shared environment to send links for feedback.

The platform is positioned as a collaborative hub where humans and AI agents can work together on creative projects. Igel described the service as a way to integrate agents into the creative workflow to act as partners in the editing process.
